title: 🌀 Pseudo-3D Spaces

accepted_baseline.label: Four-scene monumental Spaces engine
preserve: Map 4/visible scene 3 world-anchored tunnel optical flow
Map 5/visible scene 4 bridge-last occlusion and max two signs

current_candidate.summary: Spaces v33 keeps the liked four-scene set and applies the latest global/magtower feedback. Wheel/trackpad movement is now inertial and consumed over frames instead of discrete nudge jumps, while keyboard/arrow behavior remains continuous. Map 5 preserves the .36 full-width hairline path and moves radius-3.2 towers farther outward with gap 3.00 (tower center ±6.38, inner surface ±3.18). The old giant cardboard boards are replaced by sparse small neon blade signs, tiny facade light slits and occasional slow orbital neon rings that wrap the cylindrical towers using rear/front painter passes. Map 1, calzada and tunnel renderers are unchanged from v32.

open_feedback: Review wheel/trackpad motion across all visible scenes: it should accelerate/decelerate smoothly instead of jumping targetCamZ on each wheel event.
Review Map 5 spacing: towers now have 3.00 world units of real lateral void from the .18 bridge edge to the nearest tower surface.
Review Map 5 neon scale cues: micro-lights should read tiny relative to towers; only occasional towers should show a slow orbital ring.
Review deployable signs: they are now small vertical neon blades rather than giant tan cardboard panels.
Map 1, calzada and tunnel should remain visually unchanged from v32.
